notes.title: Local Multiplayer (you can play with friends on your local PC)
notes.content:
Added a local multiplayer feature. Now you can enjoy playing Need for Conquest together with your friends on the same PC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40353646/acd01479978b8bee510dcfe0c9b24f5ca9e5adc8.png[/img]

notes.title: Player Assistance
notes.content: Added battle predictions for all possible arrows (displayed after click on arrow)

notes.title: Procedural Generation Improvement
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [i]Generation Complexity[/i] parameter added to procedural generation settings
[*] Up to 10 territories with stones possible in procedurally generated maps
[/list]

notes.title: AI Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - improved AI for [i]Slow Conquer[/i] mode.
[*] - display predictions for battle results
[/list]

notes.title: Additional Features
notes.content:
[list]
[*] All Players' statistics available during play
[*] Attack or move with all available armies by default
[*] Changed default AI to the most advanced one - Marshal 
[/list]

notes.title: UI Style Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Old London font in menus, buttons and info disks
[*] Stone Command Panel
[*] larger infantry count font on info disks 
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] improved continent capture for Marshal AI
[*] menu after Load and New Game changed to dark scheme
[*] a few minor bugs fixed
[/list]
